## Checklist

- [ ] `node --test` passes
- [ ] If it changes how pets look, I ran `npm run gallery` and checked `docs/gallery/index.html`
- [ ] New text is added to every language in `src/i18n/` (en, vi, ja, zh, ko, es, fr)
- [ ] User-facing changes have a line in `CHANGELOG.md` and in `CHANGELOG` in `src/whatsnew.js`
- [ ] If users must change their workflow, `examples/legacypet.yml`, `workflowYaml` in `src/setup.js` and the README say how
